body.name: \widehat s_c
body.construction: For each coordinate \(\ell\), set \[\widehat s_{c\ell}=K^{-1}\sum_{f=1}^L\sum_{i\in\mathcal V_{cf}}\psi_{c\ell}\!\left(O_{ci};\widehat Q_{c,-f},\widehat G_{c,-f}\right),\qquad \widehat s_c=(\widehat s_{c1},\ldots,\widehat s_{cd_c})^\top,\] with \(\widehat\Lambda_{c,-f}\) used inside the score as the product-integral hazard corresponding to \(\widehat Q_{c,-f}\).
